11. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and order of conviction and sentence passed by the High Court Division dated 14.01.2015, the convict-appellants preferred Criminal Appeal with Jail Appeals before this Division. 

 59. The confessional statement of accused Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain, Mosharaf Hossain Haji and Alal have been marked as Exhibits-10, 11, 1.2 and 13 respectively. All the three accused Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain, Mosharaf Hossain. Haji gave inculpatory confessional statements detailing the whole sequel of killing mission of the victim and each of the said accused corroborated one another without any discrepancy involving all of them in the commission of offence. On going through the confessional statements of accused Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain, Mosharaf Hossain Haji (Exhibits-10, 11 and 12), we can sum up that they were the members of Molom Party (a gang of miscreants, who use balm as a tool of committing offence) and accused Mosharaf Hossain Haji was their leader. They taking the passengers into taxi used to snatch away valuable goods from them by threat. According to their earlier plan on 25.09.2007 convict accused Md. Mukhter Hossain was driving the C.N.G. of Alal and he took the victim Rabat Karim Mukul in his CNG taxi. While he was driving the taxi he stopped it by the side of road near Chairman Bari on the false pretext of peeing and at that moment accused Mosharaf got into the taxi from the right side, accused Jahangir got into the taxi from the left side and they sat by the both side of the victim and caught hold his hands. Accused Liton sat on the lap of the victim and fastened his throat with a muffler (গামছা). Mosharaf Haji took away Tk.800.00 from the purse of victim while accused jahangir took away the mobile set of the victim and Liton took away the victim's wrist watch. During tussle with the victim accused Liton inflicted several blows on the face and head of the victim which caused seviour injuries to the victim. When jahangir wanted to drop down the victim from taxi, Liton applied the balm mixed with chili powder on the eyes of the victim and soon after the body of the victim became inert. Thereafter, the accused persons dropped the victim's senseless body by the side of a road near Army stadium. After completing their mugging they came to Motijheel and accused Mosharaf Haji gave Tk.1,000.00 and handed over. CNG taxi to Alal. On the next morning Mosharaf along with Liton and Mukhter went to the house of Jahangir. Jahangir sold out the victim's mobile set to Ridoy alias Sumon for Tk.1,700.00 and out of the said money he gave Tk.300.00 to Liton and Mukhter each and Tk.200.00 to Jahangir. Mosharaf took the rest amount of money. On the next day Eton told them that the said passenger died. Thereafter, on the 2nd day of next month as per their previous plan Mokhter was driving the taxi of Alal with a passenger and after arriving at the road infront of the High Court he stopped the taxi on a false plea of passing of urination. At that time accused Mosharaf, Jahangir and Liton got into the taxi. When they caught hold the passenger he started to scream loudly. Then another vehicle from their back started to chase their taxi and at one stage they escaped leaving the taxi on the road when they stuck in traffic signal at Matshya Bhaban point. Thereafter, the police seized the said CNG taxi. 

 60. From the deposition of P.W.18, A.B.M. Abdul Pattah, Magistrate, 1st Class, and on perusal of the confessional statements, it appears that the statements were recorded by the learned Magistrate complying with all the provisions required by law to be observed. P.W.1.8 stated in his deposition to the effect that he was satisfactorily convinced that accused Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain and Mosharaf Hossain Haji made their confessional statements before him voluntarily and those were true and he gave certificates in this respect on the Exhibits-10, 11 and 12. Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain and Mosharaf Hossain. Haji made confessional statements incriminating themselves along with the accused Li ton. Now, the question arises whether the confessional statements of Md. Jahangir Hossain, Mukhter Hossain and Mosharaf Hossain Haji can be used against Liton.
